task: Replace a ceiling fan or light fixture
steps: Turn off power at the breaker and confirm with a tester.
Support the old fixture while removing mounting screws, then disconnect wires.
Verify the electrical box is fan-rated if installing a ceiling fan.
Connect new fixture wires by color match, then secure the mounting bracket.
Attach the fixture/fan body, restore power, and test all settings.
